title: Sending Excel Files
status: rendered to Production Standards v2 (AV-synced cut)
objective: Encourage the first account placement from signed-but-inactive clients.
activation_barrier: 'My accounts live in a spreadsheet - do I have to retype everything?'
core_message: Getting your accounts to SWRS is easier than you think.

engine_mapping.obstacle: fear of retyping hundreds of rows
engine_mapping.fix: attach the Excel file and email it - we take it from there

distribution: Excel-user segment of the activation drip; auto-stops on first placement.

production.style: polished modern 3D animated commercial, cohesive cool-blue SWRS palette

models.assembly: ffmpeg in Higgsfield sandbox, Production Standards v2 + AV-synced scene retiming

v2_standards_applied: Fira Sans Bold captions and brand card
SFX: whooshes at scene cuts, pop on the send beat; silent logo reveal
AV-SYNC: scene cuts land when their lines end (5.2s / 5.2s / 9.1s / 3.5s card), scene clip audio tempo-matched
in-scene hook: Victor speaks the opening line himself
production.logo_animation: official white SWRS logo (media 38707f0b) fades in top-center on the BRAND-CLOSE CARD ONLY (t=19.7s, 0.8s alpha fade, 520px, soft drop shadow), silent reveal.
production.audio_mix: standard DUCKING mix (scene SFX 0.22x during VO 0.2-17.1s), VO 1.25-1.3x, amix normalize=0 + alimiter 0.95 + loudnorm -14 LUFS.
